 Department of Health

 Community, Mental Health & Wellbeing

 CMHW - Ambulance Tasmania





 Applications must be submitted by Sunday 12 July, 2026 11:55 PM 




Position details




 

 

 
Applications close:

 
Sunday 12 July, 2026 11:55 PM AEST

 

 

 
Award-Classification:

 
Health and Human Services (Tasmanian State Service) Award, General Stream, Band 8

 

 

Salary:

$144,169 to $153,844 pro rata, per annum


 
 

 
Employment type:

 
Permanent, full-time

 

 

 
Region:

 
South

 

 

Located in:

1-5 Melville Street, Hobart


 

 
Job description:

 
Lead education, accreditation, and compliance programs that support a skilled and high-performing Ambulance Tasmania workforce.

 

 






 

Please note this position is also being advertised as a Senior Manager - Education and Professional Development (510723d) (Public Sector Unions Wages Agreement 2025) and only one position will be filled on merit. 

The Team

Royal Hobart Hospital is Tasmania's largest hospital, and the Cardiothoracic Surgical Unit within the RHH is the tertiary referral centre for all cardiothoracic surgery in Tasmania. As the major clinical teaching and research centre, RHH works closely with the University of Tasmania and other institutions. All our services work closely together to focus on delivering excellence in healthcare to achieve improved outcomes for our consumers, our workforce, and the Tasmanian community.

The Role

Develop, implement and evaluate education and clinical support programs for initial, continuing, remediation, and clinical accreditation for all operational staff, and relevant education and clinical support programs for non-operational staff.

Ensure all Ambulance Tasmania staff are compliant with Department of Health Core Learning.

Ensure all clinical staff are compliant with the Ambulance Tasmania Credentialing Framework and provide key reports on credentialing to the Director - Education.

You will need

Demonstrated experience in the management of organisation-wide clinical and other educational functions within a complex environment.

Demonstrated understanding of the VET sector including the management of an RTO or the capacity to rapidly acquire this knowledge.

Demonstrated understanding of the Tertiary education sector or the capacity to rapidly acquire this knowledge.

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. Additionally, it provides community health, mental health, and primary healthcare services to the Tasmanian community through more than 300 sites.

Tasmania, Australia's only island state, offers unparalleled natural beauty and a luxurious lifestyle. Pursuing your health career in Tasmania's public health system means building strong connections with colleagues and patients. It also means embracing a lifestyle where you can enjoy extraordinary experiences outside of work while making a significant impact on the community during work.

Details of appointment

Permanent full time, day worker position, working 76 hours per fortnight, commencing as soon as possible.

*Notwithstanding hours to be negotiated with the successful applicant.

Applicants should note that, for a period of twelve months from the date of publication, this selection process may be used to fill subsequent or similar full time, part time, and casual vacancies.

Salary - General Stream Band 8 

$144,169 to $153,844 per annum. Our Employer 12% superannuation contribution is on top of this amount.

Salary range is in accordance with Public Sector Unions Wages Agreement 2025.

Salary Packaging

You'll have access to salary package a range of benefits including living expenses up to $9,010 + $2,650 in meal entertainment each FBT year + other benefits if eligible.

Benefits available to eligible candidates 

Professional development and accelerated pathways.

A range of leave entitlements, including study leave and Professional Development Support.

Fitness Passport - You, and your family can access 40+ fitness facilities across Tasmania for just $14.50 per week per person, or $28.05 for a family.

More information about our Employee Benefits can be found here

Eligibility

Applicants should note the following criteria are desirable:

Appropriate tertiary qualifications in education or significant progress towards completion of a tertiary education qualification.

Relevant experience working in a health-related field.

Note: - Please refer to the Application Guide for more information of pre-employment check.

Download the Statement of Duties and any Associated Documents

We encourage you to review the Statement of Duties, Applicant Guide, prior to applying for an overview of the duties, program, selection process and application guidance.

Statement of Duties: 

Senior Manager - Education and Professional Development (Band 8).docx

Application Guide: 

Applicant Guide.docx

How to apply

Apply Online. Please click the "Apply" button on this screen to ensure that important questions about you are answered.

You will be prompted to complete a 1-2 page application detailing your experience, skills and knowledge as they relate to the attached Statement of Duties. A separate statement addressing the selection criteria in the Statement of Duties is not required.

*applications from Recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role

For more information

Applicants who require further information are encouraged to contact the Contact person for detailed information about the vacancy.

Andrew Howard

I-Director, Education 

andrew.howard@ambulance.tas.gov.au

Compassion, Accountability, Respect, Excellence are the key values to work in Department of Health. Listen to some of the lived experiences from within the department through some of our wonderful staff and hear about their journey in relocating to Tasmania!

result.description: BRIC Consulting Engineers  BRIC Consulting Engineers is looking for a full-time Civil Engineering Technician to join our team.   Benefits  The remuneration for this position is AU$75,000 - AU$85,000 per annum plus superannuation.   Task & responsibilities  - Assisting Civil Engineering Professionals with the planning, design and delivery of residential, civil and commercial engineering projects by providing technical support throughout project lifecycles.  - Conducting field inspections and site investigations to obtain engineering data, verify existing site conditions and identify issues relevant to the preparation and implementation of engineering designs.  - Performing tests and evaluations of construction materials, including soil, aggregates and concrete, and recording, interpreting and reporting test results to support engineering assessments and compliance requirements.  - Collecting, analysing and tabulating engineering, survey and construction data to assist in the preparation of technical reports, design calculations and project documentation.  - Preparing engineering sketches, technical drawings and computer-aided design (CAD) documentation based on engineering specifications, project requirements and applicable Australian Standards.  - Assisting in the preparation and revision of civil engineering plans, layouts, details and supporting documentation to facilitate construction activities and regulatory approvals.  - Monitoring construction activities and inspecting works to verify conformity with approved drawings, engineering specifications, contractual requirements and relevant statutory regulations.  - Assisting in the identification, investigation and resolution of technical issues arising during design development and construction by liaising with engineers, contractors and other project stakeholders.  - Preparing quantity estimates, material schedules and cost information to support project planning, procurement activities and budget estimations.  - Reviewing engineering documentation, specifications and technical submissions to verify completeness, accuracy and compliance with project and regulatory requirements.  - Maintaining accurate project records, inspection reports, testing results and technical documentation in accordance with organisational procedures and quality management requirements.  - Coordinating with surveyors, architects, contractors, local authorities and utility service providers to facilitate project delivery and ensure effective communication between stakeholders.  - Supporting the implementation of workplace health and safety, environmental and quality assurance procedures during site inspections and project execution.  - Assisting with the preparation of engineering reports, technical correspondence and client documentation by presenting engineering information in a clear, accurate and professional manner.      Qualification & experience  Qualifications  - AQF Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Design, Engineering Technology, or a closely related discipline.  - A higher qualification, such as a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, will be considered favourably but is not essential.    Experience  - At least 1 year experience in a civil engineering, structural engineering or engineering consultancy environment.    Skills  - Civil engineering and construction knowledge.  - Technical drawing and CAD proficiency.  - Engineering data collection, analysis and reporting.  - Construction materials testing and quantity estimating.  - Interpretation of engineering drawings and specifications.  -Effective communication and organisational skills.  About Company    BRIC Consulting Engineers is a privately-owned Australian Structural, Civil and Commercial Engineering Consultancy based in Rivervale, Western Australia. Since 2020, we’ve delivered engineering services on thousands of residential, civil and commercial projects across Western Australia. From small-scale developments to complex commercial government projects, our focus is simple: practical, cost-effective and compliant engineering solutions that work in the real world.         Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $75000-85000   Job Publish:  09-07-2026   Job Expire:  08-08-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=6005106   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Lead with Heart, Manage with Purpose - Join Us at Newmarch House, Kingswood

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced clinical professional to join our exceptional team as a Residential Care Manager within our vibrant Aged Care Facility - Newmarch House, Kingswood. In this role you will be responsible for the effective leadership of a facility, ensuring culture, processes and practices are in accordance with the organisational strategies and policies, and ensuring residents are well cared for in a caring environment. This position provides a great opportunity to apply your aged care knowledge and management experience to a senior role within Anglicare.

Your opportunity 

Undertake the overall responsibility of the operations of the home to deliver high quality services to residents and their families

Creating a positive work culture for our staff through effective leadership and HR management

Management of finances and budgets

Ensure Quality planning, implementation and evaluation

Promoting an interactive WH&S system to ensure optimum health and wellbeing of staff

What you'll bring 

A high level of business acumen including strong financial management experience

Leadership skills and the ability to delegate

Aged Care experience highly desirable

Previous management experience of diverse teams

Knowledge of ACFI, the Aged Care Act, WHS, accreditation and continuous improvement

A passion for Aged Care

A commitment to the Christian Values of Anglicare

Clinical background as an RN or related discipline is highly desirable

Current AHPRA nursing registration desirable

Why Anglicare? 

We provide meaningful opportunities and choice, both for the individuals and communities we support and the dedicated people here who make it happen. 

At Anglicare, you'll get the security, stability and opportunities that come with a strong, well-established organisation that's ready for the future. You'll belong to a community of kind, humble and respectful people of all faiths and backgrounds. You will also be supported to gain new knowledge, deepen your experience and expertise, and shape a rewarding career. 

On top of that, here are just some of the tangible benefits you will enjoy in a career with us: 

Flexible work options to get the most out of work and life 

Increase your take-home pay with salary packaging 

Ongoing professional development and leadership training to advance your career 

Exclusive discounts to over 400 retailers 

Employee Assistance Program and Fitness Passport with discounts to over 800 gyms for you and your family 

Are you ready for a career that means more? 

To apply for this role, please click the 'Apply' button. All applicants will receive a response. 

Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. While we are guided by our Christian-based values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds who share our commitment to serving others, and we value the diverse perspectives they bring.

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds. 

Please note that successful completion of background checks and NDIS Worker Screening Check Clearance may be required as part of the employment process for this role.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Mental Health Nurse Manager



 Apply now
 Job no: 942773

 Work type: Full time

 Location: Adelaide Metro Eastern

 Categories: Mental Health, Nursing-Midwifery





 

Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network 

Rural and Remote Mental Health Service - Parkside 

Salary: RN-M3A $130,190 to $136,010 p.a. + any penalties 

Fulltime, Temporary - 2 year contract

WHAT ARE WE OFFERING? 

We are offering a unique temporary full-time opportunity for an experienced nurse or midwife to take on a strategic leadership role within the Rural and Remote Mental Health Service (RRMHS) to provide strengthened leadership across recruitment, rostering, NHPPD application and monitoring and workforce stabilisation for RRMHS and to support the commissioning and stabilisation of the new mental health services. You will lead and support key projects and programs that strengthen workforce capability, improve practice consistency, and enhance safe, high-quality patient outcomes, while providing expert advice across professional practice, workforce, education, and research.

WHO ARE WE? 

The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Our mission is to ensure that you always receive the best quality, safe, consistent, collaborative care and always with kindness. We do this by maintaining exceptional levels of care at all times supported by systems and processes that assure us of quality and safety of our staff and those we serve. 

WHERE AND HOW WILL YOU WORK 

Parkside, South Australia is a well-located inner-southern suburb just minutes from Adelaide's CBD, known for its leafy streets, convenient transport options, and easy access to local caf s, parks, and everyday amenities. 

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 

Proven ability to lead and manage projects and programs, with strong skills in workforce planning, management of nursing budgets and resource allocation, workforce implementation within a healthcare setting.

Demonstrated expertise in nursing and midwifery professional practice, with the capacity to provide advice on workforce, legislation and education, and research.

Strong strategic thinker with experience in driving improvements in healthcare systems, quality, and patient outcomes.

Well-developed leadership and influencing skills, with the capability to engage stakeholders, contribute to advisory groups, and lead change across multidisciplinary teams.

Experience in roster development, workforce management, quality improvement, data analysis and performance monitoring, including developing KPIs, using information systems, and applying research and evidence to inform decision-making and practice.

Knowledge of vaccination requirements and immunisation as applied to regional healthcare contexts.

 

If you have answered yes to any of these questions - then read on. 

HOW WILL YOU CONTRIBUTE? 

You will.... 

Lead, coordinate and deliver complex mental health nursing and midwifery projects and programs, ensuring effective planning, implementation, evaluation and alignment with RRMHS strategic priorities.

Provide expert advice and guidance on professional practice, workforce, education and policy to support evidence-based decision-making and improved outcomes.

Drive quality improvement and consistency in practice by developing, implementing and evaluating policies, protocols and performance measures.

Influence and collaborate with key stakeholders, including advisory groups and multidisciplinary teams, to support system-wide improvements and change initiatives.

Utilise data, research and information systems to monitor performance, inform strategy and strengthen workforce capability and service delivery. 

 

WHAT WILL WE OFFER YOU IN RETURN? 

At BHFLHN, not only will you be working in an environment surrounded by beautiful scenery and nature we see your work here as not just as a job, but an opportunity to extend, progress or consolidate your career with us. We therefore offer you opportunities to be supported in the following ways: 

Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT year Click here more information 

Access to generous leave provisions and professional development opportunities. 

Support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program. 

Health and Fitness Benefits: Access to Fitness Passport, a discounted workplace health and fitness program available to BHFLHN staff and their families. 

WHAT ELSE DO YOU NEED TO KNOW-WHAT IS ESSENTIAL FOR SUCCESS? 

Working in this environment, it is important to us that we only employ people with the utmost integrity and commitment to serving the South Australian community and its visitors to the highest possible standards. To ensure that we meet that commitment there are a few checks that you will be required to undertake. These are detailed on the Role Description, but are likely to include the following: 

You will need to be immunised. Please contact the Enquiries Person for this position if you have any queries. Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy. Further information is in the application for to help guide you. 

You will need to undergo employment screening, what you require is also on the front page of the Role Description.

REQ676262 - St George Hospital - Midwifery Unit Manager 2 - Antenatal Clinic - Temporary Full Time
 
The Role

The vision for South Eastern Sydney Local Health District (SESLHD) is 'exceptional people, healthier lives'. SESLHD is committed to enabling our community to be healthy and well, and to providing the best possible compassionate care when people need it. 

All staff are expected to act as an appropriate and effective role model and promote culture and supporting practices that reflect the NSW Health CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Respect and Empowerment through demonstrated behaviours and interactions with patients, clients and employees. All staff are expected to take reasonable care that their actions do not adversely affect the health and safety of others, that they comply with any reasonable instruction that is given them and with any reasonable policies-procedures relating to health or safety in the workplace, as well as notifying any hazards-risks or incidents to their managers. 

The vision for nursing and midwifery at St George Hospital is to provide meaning and purpose to plan for the future;have reference to an inspirational statement that is consistent with the purpose and values of nursing and midwifery;and to inspire nurses and midwives to provide the highest quality healthcare to patients in any circumstance. The Vision Statement is:'Nurses and midwives at St George Hospital are always compassionate and competent in the delivery of excellent patient and family centered care.' Eight core behaviours were identified as being integral to achieving the vision:team player;caring;respectful;honest;advocate;collaborative;considerate and accountable. 

The Midwifery Unit Manager is the registered Midwife in charge of a ward-unit or group of wards-units or a service (e.g. Child and Family Health) within SESLHD. The purpose of the Midwifery Unit Manager grade 2 (MUM2) is to:lead, direct and co-ordinate patient or client care;ensure the practice of nursing and-or midwifery is safe and efficient, maintaining standards of care through continual quality improvement initiatives;lead and coordinate the nursing and midwifery and multidisciplinary care team at the ward or unit level, and monitor and manage the business and management functions and processes of the ward or unit;As the leader of the unit, the MUM2 will demonstrate her-his capability through attitude, skills, behaviour and attributes, namely:broad midwifery experience and knowledge;understanding and acceptance that patients are the central focus of service delivery;professional integrity;ethical conduct;accountability;advocacy;enabling others;cultivation of collaborative relationships and effective team work;commitment to advancing the profession of midwifery and care provision. The Midwifery Unit Manager Level 2, whose responsibilities in relation to patient services, ward or unit management and staff management are in excess of those of a Midwifery Unit Manager Level 1.

Benefits
 

Up to 12 allocated days off each year (for full-time employees) in addition to annual leave.

Salary packaging optionsthat reduce your taxable income and increase your take-home pay! Up to $9K for living expenses and $2.6K meal & entertainment & Novated Leasing.

Discounted gym memberships with a Fitness Passport.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and family members.

Discounted Private Health Insurance.

Selection Crtieria

Current registration as a Registered Midwife with the Nursing & Midwifery Board of Australia.

Relevant management tertiary qualification or equivalent work experience, or a combination of study and work experience with a demonstrated commitment to professional development.

A demonstrated knowledge and experience in the management and delivery of health care services.

Proven ability in innovative clinical service delivery, harm minimisation and practice development.

Effective interpersonal and communication skills that demonstrate the ability to engage, enable and manage teams.

Proven ability to create and maintain a positive workplace culture and articulate and achieve a vision for midwifery services.

Demonstrated recent midwifery management experience in the specialty in an acute care facility.

Apply decorative finishes, textures and specialised coatings where required.  Protect surrounding areas using masking materials and drop sheets to maintain a clean worksite.  Inspect completed work to ensure compliance with project specifications and company quality standards.  Maintain painting tools, equipment and materials in a safe and serviceable condition. Strong attention to detail with a commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship.  Good communication, organisational and time management skills.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  Current Australian Driver's Licence and White Card are preferred.  Full Australian working rights.
